description: Duplicate effects on their layers (Edit > Duplicate), move an effect up or down the layer's effect stack (drag in the Effect Controls panel), or copy effects with their keyframes and expressions to other layers in the composition (Edit > Copy, Edit > Paste; uses the clipboard and opens the composition in the Composition panel)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

effects.description: Applied effects by name, match name or position (1 = top); omit for all (one effect for move)

items.description: An effect already on the layer: its name in the Effect Controls panel (e.g. "Gaussian Blur 2"), its match name, or its position (1 = top)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true. For copy_to_layers, one source layer

position.description: move: the new position in the stack, 1 = top

to.description: copy_to_layers: the layers to paste the effects onto

name: organize_effects
title: Organize Effects
